entries.category_description: Accommodation provided in hotels and similar establishments, including the provision of holiday accommodation and the letting of places on camping or caravan sites
entries.code_description: Camping grounds and recreational vehicle parks services
entries.comment: In this category, also the short-term accommodation (airbnb type) is included, only in the case where the lessor is (a) a legal entity or (b) natural person, who shall supply at least 3 immovable properties (e.g. house, flat, rooms in a flat etc) in order to be included. In ALL other cases of short-term accommodation (i.e. NATURAL persons that supply 1 or 2 immovable properties) this service is VAT exempted.

entries.category_description: Accommodation provided in hotels and similar establishments, including the provision of holiday accommodation and the letting of places on camping or caravan sites
entries.code_description: Camping grounds and recreational vehicle parks services
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. b.10: providing the opportunity to camp within the context of a camping and holiday business to persons who only stay there for a short period. The term "camp and holiday business" should be interpreted according to parlance. It is not required that the lessor provides the additional services that camping sites normally provide. 'providing the opportunity to camp' must also be interpreted according to parlance.
